title: AEFS: Adaptive Explainable Feature Selection for Cross-Project Software Defect Prediction
description: Artifact of the AEFS (Adaptive Explainable Feature Selection) framework for cross-project software defect prediction: reference implementation, four public benchmark pools (AEEEM, TeraPromise, NASA MDP, ReLink; 80 project-versions), raw per-fold results of every experiment, analysis CSVs behind every reported number, and independent replication runs.
